claimsToVerify: Spartan boys entered the agoge around age seven.
The agoge was a state-run training system.
Spartan boys were encouraged to steal food to develop stealth and resourcefulness.
Spartan boys were punished for getting caught stealing, not for the act itself.
Spartan education focused on physical training and basic literacy.
